tools.name: generate_qr
tools.description: Generate a scannable QR code (PNG or SVG) for a URL, plain text, Wi-Fi login, contact card (vCard), SMS, WhatsApp, map location, or calendar event. Every result is decode-verified server-side before it is returned. Free, no API key. Powered by HonestQR (https://qr.zalize.com).

tools.name: generate_pixel_art_qr
tools.description: Generate an artistic QR code with pixel art embedded via a halftone technique: pixel text (up to 8 Latin characters/digits) or one of the built-in pixel icons, plus optional gradient color themes. The QR stays fully scannable (error correction H + server-side decode verification). Use list_icons and

tools.name: decode_qr
tools.description: Decode a QR code from a PNG image (base64). Returns the raw payload and its detected content type (url, wifi, vcard, sms, geo, event, ...).

tools.name: list_themes
tools.description: List the available color themes (solid and gradient) for generate_qr and generate_pixel_art_qr.

tools.name: list_icons
tools.description: List the built-in pixel icon ids for generate_pixel_art_qr, with an ASCII preview of each 16x16 icon.
